question: The Salt Satyagraha of 1930 directly challenged which British action?

options.text: Exclusive control over salt production and sale

solution:
The correct answer is __**Exclusive control over salt production and sale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Salt Satyagraha**, also known as the **Dandi March**, was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi on **March 12, 1930**, to protest against the **British monopoly over salt production and taxation.**
 
• Salt was an essential commodity used by every individual, and the British government imposed a tax on it, restricting Indians from producing or selling it independently.
 
• The march began from **Sabarmati Ashram** in Ahmedabad and ended in **Dandi**, a coastal village in Gujarat, covering a distance of **240 miles** (approximately 386 kilometers).
